patterns.name: feedback_to_draft_to_human_decision
patterns.tested_result: Rendered illustrative customer-feedback signal with matching ownership-focused headline and social draft; final human note selects one and requests revision of the other.
patterns.guidance: Keep source quote visible in draft rationale. Use explicit human decision language in Slack. Distinguish draft outputs from publishing and preserve readable holds.
patterns.limitations: One subjective film review; no audience or product-behavior validation.

patterns.name: native_speed_existing_reading_insert
patterns.tested_result: Selected a short quiet reviewing insert; supported arms and laptop gaze retained, soft face detail unchanged.
patterns.guidance: Use UI inserts to explain decisions rather than claim a generated finger movement performs an exact click.
patterns.limitations: No new human model experiment or causal inference.
